source_truth.answer: Palomino is a 1965-1967 social-housing estate on Avenida Venezuela whose repeated T module forms curved blocks and routes around shared open space and incorporated archaeological remains; it remains residential.

original_spatial_contract.answer: Housing, recreation and circulation were intended as a self-contained urban cell: modular repetition produces differentiated courtyards and curved pedestrian sequences rather than isolated slab blocks.

current_life.answer: Residence, walking, waiting, play, care, maintenance and informal adaptation are credible, but no specific current activity window or unrestricted internal access is established.

architectural_causality.answer: T-shaped modules, curved alignments, external circulation and shared lawns bend paths and create variable enclosures, while weak hierarchy can also make movement uncertain.

visual_forensic_saturation.answer: Aerial masterplan, empty green court and formal block-rhythm images dominate. The underrepresented relationship is a current resident action caused by a specific curve, threshold or later adaptation.

light_material_geometry.answer: Garúa reduces heterogeneous paint/additions and clarifies curved massing; lateral light can separate repeated façades and external circulation but must not turn inhabited homes into anonymous pattern.

position_then_optics.answer: Test a clearly public entrance-to-curve view, a path tangent between blocks and an exterior-circulation overlap. Start 35 mm for enclosure, 50 mm for turn/threshold and 85 mm only when shared-space context remains.

moment_logistics_ethics.answer: Verify public access and resident tolerance, never aim into dwellings, avoid identifiable children and vulnerable residents, do not treat adaptations as spectacle, and kill any proof that requires entering communal/private territory without permission.

one_frame_contest_test.answer: The frame passes when modular curvature visibly channels a current action or exposes meaningful navigational ambiguity. Empty modernist form, resident-as-scale or aerial-plan imitation fails.

original_spatial_contract.answer: A double stair lifts visitors to a screened gallery and main rooms, organizing formal arrival, rest, reception and governance above the garden.

current_life.answer: Government sources document museum visitation and group reservation; current hours, exhibit state and photography rules require direct confirmation.

visual_forensic_saturation.answer: Empty heritage façade, period-room object and romantic night garden dominate. The underused frame makes ascent through the raised threshold the story.

light_material_geometry.answer: Soft daylight reveals quincha surfaces, stair symmetry and veranda depth; hard frontal light or decorative night illumination flattens the transition.

one_frame_contest_test.answer: The frame passes when raised domestic/state architecture visibly choreographs present learning. A famous-house façade or object display without movement fails.

records.name: Plaza a la Bandera

source_truth.answer: Plaza a la Bandera is a recognized Pueblo Libre civic node and part of the municipal historical/archaeological corridor.

original_spatial_contract.answer: A monumental central axis, open apron, steps and perimeter approaches create a ceremonial room for collective national commemoration and district gathering.

current_life.answer: People cross, wait, circulate and periodically assemble for ceremonies or programs; exact events and everyday density require direct observation.

human_verbs_or_meaningful_absence.answer: Cross, wait, approach, ascend, gather, salute, watch and disperse are credible. Crossing or dispersing across the civic axis is more repeatable than ceremony.

architectural_causality.answer: Steps, radial/axial paving and the elevated flag focus channel approach, orientation and assembly while surrounding roads constrain entry.

visual_forensic_saturation.answer: Centered flag/monument panoramas and ceremony coverage dominate. The underused relation is a lateral everyday crossing made monumental by scale and paving.

light_material_geometry.answer: Garúa can reduce patriotic color spectacle and emphasize paving/step geometry; low sun can clarify axial shadows but risks a generic monument silhouette.

position_then_optics.answer: Test lateral pedestrian entry, step tangent and opposite perimeter alignment. Start 35 mm for plaza/road/figure, 50 mm for crossing/axis and 85 mm only if civic scale remains legible.

moment_logistics_ethics.answer: Use designated crossings and public apron, never stand in traffic, verify barriers/events, avoid exploiting ceremonial participants and fall back to ordinary circulation.

one_frame_contest_test.answer: Passes only when plaza geometry changes movement or assembly. Flag recognition, patriotic symbolism or isolated person-as-scale fails.

records.name: Parque Virginia Candamo

source_truth.answer: Virginia Candamo is a 6,591.40-square-metre maintained public park redesigned with circular paths, landscaping, LED lighting, older-adult gym, Confucius monument and Chinese pergola.

original_spatial_contract.answer: The redesign joined neighborhood recreation and older-adult exercise with a Chinese-Peruvian commemorative landscape structured by paths, pergola and planted rooms.

current_life.answer: Walking, sitting, exercising, accompanying and landscape care are credible; current equipment use, lighting and programmed activity require field confirmation.

human_verbs_or_meaningful_absence.answer: Walk, exercise, rest, meet, supervise, maintain, pass through and shelter are credible. A path-mediated meeting or exercise/rest contrast is stronger than posing at the monument.

architectural_causality.answer: Circular paths distribute movement among gym, pergola and lawns; shaded enclosure and equipment invite different speeds and age groups to share the park.

visual_forensic_saturation.answer: Aerial redesign and colorful inauguration/Confucius imagery dominate. The underused relation is ordinary movement and care across two differently programmed park rooms.

light_material_geometry.answer: Garúa can balance bright commemorative elements with vegetation and reveal path circles; night LED claims are stale until observed.

position_then_optics.answer: Test path tangent between gym/pergola, residential-edge-to-center diagonal and care-work layer. Start 35 mm for program relation, 50 mm for encounter and 85 mm only for material/use without cultural-object isolation.

moment_logistics_ethics.answer: Use public paths, avoid identifiable children/older adults without consent, do not exoticize cultural symbols, verify equipment/lighting and keep exercise routes clear.

one_frame_contest_test.answer: Passes when the redesigned path/program system visibly enables intergenerational use or care. Pagoda/Confucius portrait, color spectacle or generic park activity fails.

records.name: Unidad Vecinal Nº3

source_truth.answer: UV3 is a 1945-1949 modern social-housing unit of roughly 1,112-1,115 dwellings organized around central commercial, civic, educational, religious and recreational facilities with pedestrian/traffic separation.

original_spatial_contract.answer: Compact housing preserved extensive shared green/recreation space; internal pedestrian routes, perimeter traffic, cul-de-sacs and green belt were intended to protect daily family/community life.

current_life.answer: Residence, crossing, commerce, play, care and adaptation continue, while narrowed paths, deteriorated equipment, lighting, waste/maintenance and safety issues reshape use.

human_verbs_or_meaningful_absence.answer: Enter, exit, walk, detour, meet, play, shop, maintain and appropriate are credible. Detouring around an extension or continuing through a surviving pedestrian axis can make transformation legible.

architectural_causality.answer: Pedestrian spines, cul-de-sacs, central facilities and block/open-space proportions originally direct safe movement; later extensions and enclosures can narrow or contradict that contract.

visual_forensic_saturation.answer: Masterplan diagrams, historic green-space panoramas and typical-block documentation dominate. The underused frame is a precise original-device/current-adaptation conflict at human height.

light_material_geometry.answer: Garúa can unify modifications and clarify path width/block rhythm; lateral light can expose additions and thresholds but must not aestheticize deterioration.

position_then_optics.answer: Test public perimeter-to-pedestrian axis, cul-de-sac transition and central-service approach. Start 35 mm for contract/change, 50 mm for detour/threshold and 85 mm only if shared-space context survives.

moment_logistics_ethics.answer: Verify public access and safety, do not photograph into homes, avoid identifiable children/vulnerable residents, never frame poverty or deterioration as rarity, and retreat if resident privacy conflicts.

one_frame_contest_test.answer: Passes when an original device visibly enables, channels or is contradicted by present action. Historic-modernist nostalgia, decay texture or residents-as-scale fails.

records.name: Unidad Vecinal Matute + complejo deportivo

source_truth.answer: Matute is a two-stage modern housing unit organized around shared spaces; its central sports facility was remodeled, expanded and inaugurated in May 2026.

original_spatial_contract.answer: Housing blocks, green interiors, protected pedestrian circulation, schools/civic equipment and a central sports area were composed as a self-sufficient neighborhood with city- and domestic-scale spaces.

current_life.answer: Residence and neighborhood circulation continue, and the renewed complex serves children, youth and adults; routine schedules, density and internal-path access require field confirmation.

human_verbs_or_meaningful_absence.answer: Exit, cross, train, play, watch, supervise, wait, meet and return are credible. Crossing from dwelling scale into shared sport is stronger than isolated athletic action.

architectural_causality.answer: Block spacing, pilotis passage, interior green routes and central field distribute residents between private dwelling and communal recreation.

visual_forensic_saturation.answer: Historic block elevations, aerial plans and inauguration/court coverage dominate. The underused frame links a current housing threshold to renewed sport through an original route.

light_material_geometry.answer: Garúa can unify old/new materials and clarify block distance; lateral light can reveal pilotis and court boundaries but must not turn residents or aging housing into texture.

position_then_optics.answer: Test public perimeter-to-field, pilotis/path and school/sport edge. Start 35 mm for housing-route-sport, 50 mm for threshold/action and 85 mm only if shared-space causality remains.

moment_logistics_ethics.answer: Verify facility access and schedules, remain on public routes, avoid identifiable children and private windows, do not obstruct training, and use an exterior fallback if residential or sports access is denied.

one_frame_contest_test.answer: Passes when original shared-space design visibly channels present recreation. Old/new juxtaposition, sports spectacle or resident-as-scale without a route fails.

visual_forensic_saturation.answer: Heroic façade, empty interiors and high-profile event stages dominate. The underused relation is operational: threshold queue becoming vertical distribution within the architectural section.

light_material_geometry.answer: Garúa and covered shade can expose concrete/glass strata and silhouettes; evening internal glow can reveal stacking but may become a generic corporate night image.

position_then_optics.answer: Test north public approach, covered-plaza edge and permitted vertical foyer. Start 35 mm for plaza/stack, 50 mm for queue/level split and 85 mm only when multiple strata remain causal.

one_frame_contest_test.answer: Passes when covered plaza/vertical section visibly organizes present assembly. Monumental form, celebrity stage or crowd scale without building agency fails.

visual_forensic_saturation.answer: Aerial ancient/modern contrast and empty mound overview dominate. The underused relation is a ground-level threshold or perimeter movement visibly shaped by the archaeological edge.

light_material_geometry.answer: Low lateral light can reveal tapia steps and enclosure; garúa can equalize monument and city, but material texture or skyline contrast without a boundary verb fails.

position_then_optics.answer: Test three legal edges: residential/perimeter, institutional backdrop and authorized activity threshold. Start 35 mm for boundary context, 50 mm for guided/edge action and 85 mm only if both monument and urban actor remain causal.

moment_logistics_ethics.answer: Verify admission and event authorization directly, stay outside closed fences, avoid identifiable children and vulnerable-neighborhood framing, and kill all internal proofs without sanctioned access.

one_frame_contest_test.answer: Passes when archaeological form visibly governs present access, education or neighborhood movement. A ruin/tower contrast or event documentation without spatial agency fails.

original_spatial_contract.answer: Differently sized dwellings share planted passages, stairs and small exterior gardens, mediating between avenue-facing houses and smaller inner homes while preserving individual variation within a collective order.

current_life.answer: The ensemble remains conserved with renovations and appears to retain residential/hospitality occupation, but current resident rhythms, internal access and photography permission require direct verification.

human_verbs_or_meaningful_absence.answer: Enter, return, unlock, climb, tend, pause, greet and pass are credible only when directly observed. Empty paired thresholds can instead carry meaningful domestic expectation without exposing residents.

visual_forensic_saturation.answer: Picturesque courtyard, isolated colourful house and ornament catalogue recur. The underrepresented relation is the collective route distributing distinct inhabited thresholds while screening avenue intensity.

light_material_geometry.answer: Soft garúa can unify red floors, timber, stucco and vegetation; lateral light can articulate arches and stairs, but decorative colour alone cannot substitute for the shared-dwelling mechanism.

moment_logistics_ethics.answer: Treat inner paths as residential/private until permission is explicit, avoid doors/windows and identifiable residents, never block access, and use the public threshold fallback if entry is refused.

one_frame_contest_test.answer: Passes when one collective passage visibly negotiates contemporary domestic life and commercial-city pressure. Heritage prettiness, disputed authorship or an isolated façade fails.

records.name: Estación / restos del Funicular de Barranco

source_truth.answer: Barranco's funicular opened hydraulically in 1896, reopened electrically in 1930 and later became inoperative; the station remains a listed tourism resource, while restoration, museum completion and visible track condition are unresolved.

original_spatial_contract.answer: A double-track inclined system joined the upper district to the bath/coastal descent, using station, passage, machinery and slope alignment to overcome the cliff.

current_life.answer: The station persists within Barranco's tourism landscape while surrounding pedestrian and road movement continues; operation, interior visitation and completed museum use are not verified.

position_then_optics.answer: Test upper public station edge, legal passage tangent and lower sightline back up the slope. Start 35 mm for station/alignment, 50 mm for old/new route crossing and 85 mm only if incline remains legible.

moment_logistics_ethics.answer: Verify closures and structural safety on arrival, remain behind barriers, do not enter ruins or works, avoid blocking narrow passages and abandon the track proof when no safe public sightline exists.

one_frame_contest_test.answer: Passes when obsolete vertical transport visibly confronts or channels current movement. A station portrait, invented museum claim or ruin aesthetic without slope causality fails.

original_spatial_contract.answer: A domestic house and garden were adapted to living, sculpture work and collection, using rooms, thresholds and planted exterior as a continuum rather than a neutral exhibition box.

current_life.answer: Guided interpretation, exhibitions, contemplation, preservation and research animate the house and garden; specific visits are preregistered and completed events do not guarantee same-day entry.

visual_forensic_saturation.answer: House exterior, serene sculpture garden and guided-tour documentation dominate. The underused relation is a threshold sequence joining former workshop, garden interpretation and surrounding grove.

current_life.answer: Residents, staff, visitors and worshippers arrive, cross, wait, enter and leave; exact service/event peaks and same-frame overlap need observation.

human_verbs_or_meaningful_absence.answer: Cross, queue, petition, work, pray, gather, wait and depart are credible. Quiet paired thresholds can express parallel institutions only if spatial relation is visible.

architectural_causality.answer: Separate portals, setbacks and central public paths distribute people toward municipal administration or worship from a shared urban field.

visual_forensic_saturation.answer: Frontal palace and church portraits dominate. The underused relation is a ground-level crossing/choice between two institutional thresholds.

light_material_geometry.answer: Garúa can unify both neocolonial envelopes while movement differentiates functions; low light can articulate portals. Symmetry alone fails.

position_then_optics.answer: Test legal park/street diagonal, crossing median and reverse threshold alignment. Start 35 mm for pair, 50 mm if one choice gesture retains both; reject if 85 mm fragments relation.

moment_logistics_ethics.answer: Verify municipal/church schedules and interior policy, remain in public space, avoid ceremonies/confession and traffic risk, and kill the combined scene if trees/cars prevent one-frame causality.

one_frame_contest_test.answer: Passes when one public gesture visibly chooses or links civic and religious authority. Two landmarks, montage or caption-built pairing fails.

records.name: La Ermita de Barranco

source_truth.answer: La Ermita is Barranco's eighteenth-century foundational church, currently closed and under a formally contracted 480-day restoration begun in June 2026.

original_spatial_contract.answer: Church nave, roof, walls, towers and domes formed a worship and district-origin landmark connected to the descent/coastal route.

current_life.answer: Its present program is conservation work, inspection, protection and public detour—not worship or open tourism; exact work visibility needs same-day confirmation.

visual_forensic_saturation.answer: Romantic ruin, frontal yellow façade and restoration-launch ceremony dominate. The underused frame isolates a real material intervention and its effect on current passage.

light_material_geometry.answer: Garúa can join old plaster, exposed material and temporary supports; side light can reveal repaired/unrepaired seams without aestheticizing decay.

moment_logistics_ethics.answer: Never enter the work zone or obstruct crews, verify barriers and visible operations, avoid identifiable workers without approval and kill the scene if only opaque hoarding or ceremonial signage remains.

one_frame_contest_test.answer: The frame passes when original fabric visibly forces present conservation or detour. Picturesque ruin, future-promise caption or generic construction documentation fails.

original_spatial_contract.answer: Linked paths, lawns, amphitheatre, benches and perimeter streets form a central civic room intended to distribute pedestrians and host recreation, meeting and culture.

current_life.answer: Current life includes family play and accompaniment on renewed infrastructure, daily crossing and waiting, and episodic large public events; only the first two are assumed repeatable.

human_verbs_or_meaningful_absence.answer: Cross, wait, meet, sit, play, supervise, perform, watch and care are credible. Crossing toward a civic edge or supervising across the playground boundary is stronger than merely petting a cat.

architectural_causality.answer: Radial/branching paths, the amphitheatre edge, benches and the playground enclosure concentrate and separate actions, letting architecture visibly produce convergence and oversight.

visual_forensic_saturation.answer: Cat close-ups, crowded park panoramas and church/park establishing views dominate. The underrepresented relationship is care or waiting organized across a boundary and connected to the wider civic flow.

light_material_geometry.answer: Garúa simplifies foliage and signage while evening edge light can separate path crossings, amphitheatre steps and benches; strong mixed lighting risks turning the scene into visual noise.

position_then_optics.answer: Test an amphitheatre-edge diagonal, a playground-boundary sightline and a perimeter-to-path junction. Start 35 mm for civic distribution, 50 mm for supervision/threshold and 85 mm only if layers remain causally connected.

moment_logistics_ethics.answer: Observe ordinary circulation before using an event, avoid identifiable children and vulnerable people, do not obstruct paths, and abandon any frame in which cats or crowd novelty replace spatial meaning.

one_frame_contest_test.answer: The frame passes only when a park device visibly causes convergence, supervision or civic transition. Recognition, cuteness or activity without architectural causality fails.

records.name: Parque del Amor & El Beso

source_truth.answer: Parque del Amor is a designed cliff-edge public ensemble inaugurated in 1993, centered on Víctor Delfín's El Beso but also structured by curved mosaic walls, terraces, planting and coastal outlook.

original_spatial_contract.answer: Curved seating walls and outlook terraces transform the cliff edge into semi-enclosed social rooms that mediate city approach, intimate pause and ocean view.

current_life.answer: Visitors meet, sit, talk, photograph, exercise, watch the coast and pass through the malecón chain. Calendar events are possible but not assumed current.

human_verbs_or_meaningful_absence.answer: Approach, sit, lean, talk, exercise, photograph, wait, look and depart are credible. The strongest verb is turning from cityward movement into a wall-defined shared or solitary pause.

architectural_causality.answer: Curved walls bend movement, create back-to-back social territories, frame the horizon and determine where bodies sit, face and encounter one another.

visual_forensic_saturation.answer: El Beso with couple/sunset, frontal mosaic inscriptions and ocean panorama dominate. The underrepresented frame works from behind or tangent to the wall, where simultaneous social orientations reveal its spatial agency.

light_material_geometry.answer: Garúa can suppress sunset cliché and emphasize mosaic texture, curved silhouette and cliff atmosphere; low lateral light can separate wall arcs but risks generic romance.

position_then_optics.answer: Test city-to-wall approach, tangent along the curved bench and back-to-back wall territories. Begin 35 mm for city/alcove/coast, 50 mm for paired orientations and 85 mm only for layered curves with context retained.

moment_logistics_ethics.answer: Use public paths, avoid intrusive intimate close-ups, do not stage strangers or block narrow overlooks, and verify crowd/wind conditions on arrival; meaningful absence is preferable to manufactured romance.

one_frame_contest_test.answer: The frame passes when wall geometry visibly produces differing orientations or degrees of intimacy. A recognizable sculpture, couple or sunset with no spatial cause fails.

visual_forensic_saturation.answer: Sunset/ocean panoramas, tourist overlooks and mall interiors dominate. The underused frame uses an external profile to show park, cliff engineering and occupied void together.

original_spatial_contract.answer: A domestic casona became an early university site and later a gallery, auditorium and library; the retained house and inserted public program form the spatial contract to test.

current_life.answer: URP records active cultural functions and a July 2026 occupied exhibition; future program and normal visitor density remain visit-specific.

architectural_causality.answer: The retained entrance, domestic sequence and adapted gallery rooms channel visitors from Avenida Arequipa into cultural occupation; the threshold and depth sequence cause the story.

visual_forensic_saturation.answer: Institutional imagery favors clean rooms and event documentation. The less common relation is street-to-house-to-exhibition depth with an actual crossing gesture.

light_material_geometry.answer: Balanced exterior/interior light is more useful than dramatic illumination because wall thickness, doorway sequence and old/new junction must remain readable together.

position_then_optics.answer: Test outside across Avenida Arequipa for full threshold, just inside the entrance for reverse street connection, and oblique within the first gallery for old/new junction. Start at 50 mm; use 35 mm only if the street layer disappears.

one_frame_contest_test.answer: The frame passes only when the building's inherited domestic depth and present public occupation are both visible; a restored façade, empty room or isolated artwork fails.

records.name: Centro Cívico de Lima / Real Plaza

source_truth.answer: The 1966–1970 Centro Cívico y Comercial survives at Av. Garcilaso de la Vega 1337 and currently contains the operating Real Plaza Centro Cívico.

original_spatial_contract.answer: The competition project combined a central public space, multiple entrances, civic/commercial program and vertical landmark in a permeable complex intended to extend central-city movement.

current_life.answer: The current operator confirms daily 07:00–22:00 occupation with retail, food, services and events; actual circulation density and mall photography constraints remain field checks.

human_verbs_or_meaningful_absence.answer: Enter, cross, ascend, descend, shop, eat, wait and meet are credible. The decisive relation places transfer-like crossing and commercial waiting inside the original central circulation order.

architectural_causality.answer: Podium passages, central void, entrances, level changes and vertical circulation collect flows before redistributing them between city, services and commercial levels.

visual_forensic_saturation.answer: Tower low angles, skyline views and promotional mall interiors dominate. The underused frame is a human-scale section where original concrete circulation and current retail behavior visibly share one axis.

light_material_geometry.answer: Late side light or blue-hour balance can separate concrete depth, glazed/commercial insertions and moving figures; uncontrolled signage or black voids would erase the relation.

position_then_optics.answer: Test public exterior threshold into podium, eye-level central passage and a lawful opposite-side layer. Start 50 mm for flow/device relation; use 35 mm for the section or 85 mm from distance to stack concrete, retail and people.

moment_logistics_ethics.answer: Verify same-day access and photography policy, use only public permitted positions, avoid security infrastructure and identifiable minors, observe 15 minutes and cap the wait at 25 minutes.

one_frame_contest_test.answer: The frame passes when old circulation structure visibly channels today's crossing, waiting and consumption. A tower portrait or generic busy mall scene fails.

A_STRUCTURE.expected_action: Clear interval reveals entry, void and level sequence
A_STRUCTURE.edge_guards: Exclude clipped tower, dominant ads and security hardware
A_STRUCTURE.access_ethics: Public exterior only unless permission confirmed

B_HABITAR.edge_guards: Separate figures from signs, escalator rails and columns

B_HABITAR.access_ethics: Confirm mall photography policy; avoid faces/minors

C_ANTI_POSTAL.kill_trigger: Needs archival image to explain reuse
C_ANTI_POSTAL.access_ethics: Do not obstruct doorway or security line
C_ANTI_POSTAL.fallback: Empty old/new material seam with route trace

D_LIGHT_MATERIAL.edge_guards: Retain structural bay and current insertion
D_LIGHT_MATERIAL.wait_trigger: Figure separates from both tonal fields

visual_reference_families.cannot_prove: Professional photography permission, precise pedestrian peak or a legible civic-to-commercial contradiction.

records.name: Agrupamiento Chabuca Granda

source_truth.answer: The 1984 Rímac project contains 48 dwellings and 14 shops and was designed by José García Bryce as housing/commercial fabric facing the Alameda de los Descalzos.

original_spatial_contract.answer: It densified house, patio and quinta types, completed the historic block edge and used transitional common spaces to connect city, commerce and dwelling.

current_life.answer: Current scholarship continues to treat it as inhabited collective housing whose common spaces support belonging; exact shop activity, maintenance and access require direct verification.

human_verbs_or_meaningful_absence.answer: Enter, return, sell, buy, greet, watch and tend are credible. The decisive verb is a resident or customer crossing the layered threshold between Alameda-facing edge and shared housing space.

architectural_causality.answer: Completed block frontage, shop thresholds, elevated/common passages and courtyard-like transitions convert a historic street edge into graduated collective access.

visual_forensic_saturation.answer: Formal frontal documentation and Alameda context views dominate. The underrepresented scene is a present domestic/commercial crossing that reveals the typological transition without requiring a plan.

light_material_geometry.answer: Lateral light can distinguish recesses, galleries and block depth; garúa can emphasize lived surface and threshold hierarchy without romanticizing deterioration.

position_then_optics.answer: Test public block corner, shop/shared-entry axis and lawful Alameda-side distance. Start 50 mm for threshold/action, 35 mm for block-to-Alameda relation and 85 mm only when distance preserves the complete contextual layer.

moment_logistics_ethics.answer: Remain on public streets unless invited, avoid windows and identifiable children, ask before sustained photography near homes/shops, observe 20 minutes and leave if residents object.

one_frame_contest_test.answer: The frame passes when a present act makes the old typological strategy legible as lived urban continuity. A contextual façade portrait or distant monument stack fails.

B_HABITAR.edge_guards: Separate action from gate and parked vehicles

visual_reference_families.cannot_prove: That present residents use the spaces as intended; current-life observation is decisive.

Which parked vehicle, gate, laundry overlap or distant monument would erase the transition from public street to shared threshold?
Does stepping to the block corner or shared-entry axis reveal contextual continuity better than compressing Alameda and housing with 85 mm?

historical_hypothesis.purpose: 48 viviendas y locales comerciales concebidos en los años 80 para revitalizar un contexto histórico frente a la Alameda de los Descalzos sin romper su fisonomía urbana.
historical_hypothesis.current_life_claim: Sigue siendo vivienda y comercio: la arquitectura contemporánea de su época envejeció hasta convertirse ella misma en otra capa del Rímac histórico.
historical_hypothesis.friction: La obra nació como “nueva” pero contextual. Cuatro décadas después, la pregunta se invierte: ¿qué pasa cuando aquello que debía dialogar con el pasado ya se volvió pasado vivido?

historical_hypothesis.kill: Si solo reconocemos un edificio posmoderno, sin relación con el barrio ni vida doméstica, no hay tesis.

records.name: Puente de la Paz / Quebrada de Armendáriz

source_truth.answer: The 112 m pedestrian/cycle connection spans Armendáriz between Miraflores and Barranco; municipal sources establish its mobility purpose and completed public use.

original_spatial_contract.answer: The bridge was conceived to remove a long detour and connect two cliff-top pedestrian systems across a deep vehicular ravine.

current_life.answer: Opening evidence records walkers, cyclists, families, pets, skaters and people stopping at the transparent section; normal-day intensity is not yet proven.

human_verbs_or_meaningful_absence.answer: Cross, pedal, run, stop, look down and photograph are observed verbs. The decisive contradiction is fast crossing versus deliberate stopping over glass.

architectural_causality.answer: The long linear span enables uninterrupted crossing while the transparent deck and ravine view solicit stopping; two behaviors are produced by different parts of one object.

visual_forensic_saturation.answer: Opening crowds, centered symmetry, glass-floor reactions and sunset views dominate. A side-on section aligning a runner, stopped viewer and traffic below is the underrepresented relationship.

light_material_geometry.answer: Garúa suppresses the postcard coast and lets tubular structure, transparent deck and traffic channel separate tonally; hard noon light risks glare but may project useful shadows.

position_then_optics.answer: Test entrance oblique for flow split, side-on middle position for crossing/stopping, and distant cliff path for bridge-over-traffic section. Start at 50 mm; use 85 mm only from farther back to align verbs without changing their spatial relation.

moment_logistics_ethics.answer: Scout during ordinary morning use, remain outside moving lanes, cap waits at 20 minutes, avoid faces on the transparent deck, and verify current access or maintenance before committing the visit.

one_frame_contest_test.answer: The frame passes if the bridge visibly causes simultaneous transit and pause above the vehicular cut; it fails when the coast, engineering silhouette or selfie becomes the sole subject.

records.name: Damero de Lima · intersección como objeto

source_truth.answer: The Damero is Lima's historic orthogonal block and street system; the scene unit is one verified intersection, not the entire center or Plaza Mayor.

original_spatial_contract.answer: Perpendicular streets, repeated blocks and axial routes organized movement, parcels, institutions, commerce and the civic center through a legible grid.

current_life.answer: Walking, deliveries, commerce, transit and controlled vehicle access still negotiate the grid; temporary restrictions demonstrate that intersection behavior changes with operation.

human_verbs_or_meaningful_absence.answer: Cross, wait, turn, sell, deliver, drive and police are credible. The decisive event is perpendicular release of flows that makes the grid visible at street level.

architectural_causality.answer: Corner lines, repeated façades, crosswalks, controlled entries and long vanishing axes channel bodies into alternating orthogonal movements.

visual_forensic_saturation.answer: Plaza monuments, balconies and elevated grid diagrams dominate. The underused frame tests a cleaned or changing intersection where ground flows reveal the plan.

light_material_geometry.answer: Garúa can suppress signage and cable clutter; brief sun can cast orthogonal façade/corner shadows, but light is useful only when two street axes remain legible.

position_then_optics.answer: Scout all four lawful corners and any safe setback before choosing the crossing. Start 35 mm for both axes, 50 mm when an axial endpoint strengthens order and reject 85 mm if it erases the perpendicular street.

moment_logistics_ethics.answer: Verify current traffic restrictions, works, crowd and safe stopping point; never enter carriageway or block commerce, avoid identifiable vulnerable people and cap one signal-cycle test at 20 minutes.

one_frame_contest_test.answer: The frame passes only if perpendicular built lines visibly cause present crossing/turning. Heritage façades, dense street life or a map-dependent argument fails.

A_STRUCTURE.edge_guards: Exclude dominant sign, parked van and clipped corner

records.name: Casa García Bryce

source_truth.answer: Casa García Bryce/Casa Eguiguren is a 1951–1952 private dwelling at Eguiguren 221, designed on a corner site with three public edges.

original_spatial_contract.answer: A generous setback and portico lead to vestibule, living/dining and a gallery around the patio, while separate study/service circulation addresses the boulevard and park edges.

current_life.answer: It remains a dwelling in good recorded condition and exceptionally hosted a registered guided cultural event in 2025; no routine public access is established.

human_verbs_or_meaningful_absence.answer: Approach, enter, guide, observe, converse and remember are evidenced during authorized occupation. Without access, meaningful absence must rely only on public-edge traces and spatial order.

architectural_causality.answer: Setback, two-column portico, emphasized door, vestibule, gallery and patio create a controlled sequence from public edge to domestic center while separate circulation protects privacy.

visual_forensic_saturation.answer: Canonical façade, archival/current comparison and plan views dominate. The underused lawful relation compares how three public edges announce different degrees of domestic access.

light_material_geometry.answer: Natural light reinforces the portico and interior sequence; white render, painted brick, stone base and projecting volume can reveal depth without turning private life into evidence.

position_then_optics.answer: Test only public Eguiguren frontage, boulevard side and Roosevelt-park rear unless explicitly invited. Start 50 mm for portico/edge relation, 35 mm for lawful three-edge context and 85 mm for a distant material/threshold layer.

moment_logistics_ethics.answer: No interior pursuit without explicit invitation. From public space avoid windows, occupants and prolonged surveillance; if no authorized event exists, cap the survey at ten minutes and use structure-only proofs.

one_frame_contest_test.answer: The frame passes only if a lawful public-edge image makes the graduated domestic threshold legible, or an authorized event shows learning shaped by that sequence. A catalogue façade fails.

records.name: Aulario 104 · Universidad Ricardo Palma

source_truth.answer: Aulario 104 is a six-level, approximately 313 m classroom building by Juvenal Baracco and Enrique Bonilla at Universidad Ricardo Palma, executed 2009–2011.

original_spatial_contract.answer: Its long bar, split grades, double-height zones and open deambulatory organize 104 classrooms while acting as a transverse pedestrian connector across campus.

current_life.answer: URP is actively receiving and orienting students in semester 2026-II through faculty routes; exact Aulario flow, timetable and visitor access need direct institutional confirmation.

human_verbs_or_meaningful_absence.answer: Cross, climb, descend, wait, meet, enter and study are credible. The decisive relation combines opposite movement with a paused student at the classroom threshold.

architectural_causality.answer: Repeated bays, open circulation, level changes, bridges and classroom doors separate through-flow from pause while reconnecting campus levels.

visual_forensic_saturation.answer: Empty vanishing-point views, award exteriors and diagrammatic sections dominate. The underused frame compresses one circulation junction where different learning rhythms are spatially legible.

light_material_geometry.answer: Lateral light can measure repeated modules and split-grade depth; garúa can preserve students as primary contrast without turning the building into a shadow spectacle.

position_then_optics.answer: With authorization test deambulatory junction, lower split grade and opposite side of a double-height bay. Start 50 mm for movement/threshold, 35 mm for section and 85 mm only from a lawful distance to stack bridges and bodies.

moment_logistics_ethics.answer: Confirm campus access and photography policy, avoid classes and identifiable students without consent, observe 15 minutes outside circulation lines and leave if security or staff declines.

one_frame_contest_test.answer: The frame passes when architectural rhythm visibly separates crossing, waiting and entering. An empty long perspective or generic student crowd fails.

A_STRUCTURE.expected_action: Brief clear interval reveals circulation section
A_STRUCTURE.edge_guards: Avoid clipped rails, signs and endless empty axis

B_HABITAR.expected_action: Two flows cross while one student pauses at a threshold
B_HABITAR.edge_guards: Separate three actions from columns and rails
B_HABITAR.access_ethics: No class disruption or identifiable minors
B_HABITAR.fallback: Back-facing adult students crossing two bands

composition_questions: Can opposing student movements and a pause at one classroom threshold make the 313 m bar read as learning infrastructure rather than monumental length?
